annotation.title_clean: IEEE 7007-2021 IEEE Ontological Standard for Ethically Driven Robotics and Automation Systems
annotation.title_en: IEEE 7007-2021 IEEE Ontological Standard for Ethically Driven Robotics and Automation Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society, RAS/SC Standing Committee for Standards (IEEE SA)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE catalogue page for IEEE 7007-2021, an ontological standard establishing ontologies of concepts, definitions and axioms to support ethically driven design of robotics and automation systems and common terminology across communities. Also mentions the in-development P7007.1 on classifying AI risks in robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes ontologies at different abstraction levels with concepts, definitions, axioms and use cases for ethically driven robotics and automation.
Serves as a guideline or reference taxonomy for communication among robotics, ethics and related communities.
Axiomatization expressed in Common Logic Interchange Format.
Published 12 Nov 2021 by IEEE RAS Standing Committee for Standards.
P7007.1 under development to define and classify AI risks for robots, based on 7007-2021.
